linuxConductor.name: Archductor
linuxConductor.subhead: Linux-native agent execution workbench for the Perceo Suite.
linuxConductor.shortDescription: A Linux-native desktop control plane for running multiple coding agents across isolated workspaces.
heroPoints: Run multiple Shell, Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor sessions in parallel.
Give each task its own Git worktree, branch, .context directory, and port range.
Review diffs, todos, comments, PR checks, and sibling workspace conflicts.
Create, refresh, merge, archive, and restore GitHub PR work from the app.
workflow: Configure scripts, prompts, providers, and workspace defaults.
Create a workspace from a branch, prompt, GitHub issue, GitHub PR, or Linear issue.
Start Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or shell sessions.
Review changes, checks, todos, comments, and conflicts.
Create or merge the PR, archive the workspace, then repeat.

installTargets.name: AppImage / GitHub release artifact
installTargets.note: Preferred portable artifact. With no arguments it launches the GTK app; with arguments it forwards to the CLI.

installTargets.name: .deb / Ubuntu-Debian
installTargets.note: Native package built by the release workflow and local nfpm packaging.

installTargets.name: .rpm / Fedora / openSUSE
installTargets.note: Use dnf or zypper-compatible RPM installation on supported distributions.

installTargets.name: Arch / AUR
installTargets.note: AUR packaging is expected for Arch users; update pkgver and sha256sums for local validation.

installTargets.name: Flatpak (experimental)
installTargets.note: Experimental. Flatpak may require broad filesystem access for arbitrary repository paths.

requirements: Linux desktop with GTK app support.
git for worktrees, branches, diffs, and commits.
gh authenticated with gh auth login for GitHub PRs, checks, comments, and merge.
GTK4/libadwaita and Rust for source builds.
Local Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or shell auth/configuration as applicable.
features: Multiple isolated Git worktree workspaces per repository.
PTY-backed Shell, Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor sessions.
Workspace terminal, setup/run/stop controls, logs, and process lists.
Diffs, changed files, todos, local review comments, PR checks, and GitHub PR comments.
Context staging from failing checks or review comments into a selected agent session.
GitHub PR create, refresh, merge, archive, restore, and saved session history.
knownLimits: Terminal rendering is not a full terminal emulator.
Visual parity with macOS Conductor is incomplete.
Advanced prompt packs/hooks/theme/layout customization are not fully surfaced in GUI.
Linux-first; Windows/macOS packages are not current launch targets.
buildCommands:
sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y git gh sqlite3 openssh-client pkg-config libgtk-4-dev libadwaita-1-dev

cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo test -p linux-conductor-core -p linux-conductor -p linux-conductor-gtk
cargo build --workspace --release --locked
./target/release/linux-conductor-gtk
